_ghi_chu: EN-ALL GĐ 7 (trang kiến thức cặp số): mới phủ vai người yêu (nguoi_yeu) + nguồn. Các vai khác (bạn bè, đồng nghiệp, sếp, gia đình) chưa có bản Anh.

source.ten: Reference compilation (editorial draft, 2026) following the Balliett–Jordan tradition and common numerology books
source.luu_y: Draft shown by decision of the project owner (2026-09-30); a status column allows gradual review. A cultural reference, not a forecast.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Takes the lead, likes to set the pace of the relationship, shows love through protective action.
nguoi_yeu.can: Respect for their decisions and some freedom of their own.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Giving orders or comparing them with others; hurting their pride in front of other people.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Be direct and brief; offer choices instead of demands.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Gentle, considerate, remembers the small details.
nguoi_yeu.can: Reassurance that they are loved, through words and steady presence.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Cold silence, or joking about their feelings.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Gently, with questions; ask them yourself, 'what are you thinking?'.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Fun, romantic, full of surprises, good at making the other person laugh.
nguoi_yeu.can: Praise, being listened to, and a relationship that doesn't get monotonous.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Calling them childish, or being cool about their ideas.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Show interest in their stories; raise serious topics when things are relaxed.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Faithful, reliable, shows love through concrete things they do.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Broken promises, sudden changes, taking what they do for granted.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Be specific and clear; thank them for the small things they do.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Magnetic, adventurous, brings a sense of something new.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Control, jealousy, holding on too tight.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Invite them to try something new together; talk about commitment as a choice, not a tie.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Caring, warm, focused on family and a shared future.
nguoi_yeu.can: To have what they do appreciated, and commitment.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Taking their care for granted; being irresponsible.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Thank them specifically; tell them which parts you want to handle yourself.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Deep, private, slow to love and sincere.
nguoi_yeu.can: Quiet time of their own and conversations with depth.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Pushing them to show their feelings right away; invading their privacy.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Ask open questions and wait while they think; talk about ideas and meaning.

nguoi_yeu.vai: Strong, protective, takes care of the material future.
nguoi_yeu.can: Respect for their abilities and a partner who shares their drive.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Belittling their failures; fighting for power in public.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Be frank and clear; talk about shared goals.

nguoi_yeu.can: To have their ideals understood and to be loved for their fragile side too.
nguoi_yeu.tranh: Mocking their dreams; being selfish or petty.
nguoi_yeu.cach_noi: Talk about meaning and values; gently bring things back to the concrete.
